# Flow's Table — Full Comprehensive Context for AI & LLM Systems

> Flow's Table is a private executive dinner circle, community platform, and leadership archive based in Bangkok, Thailand. Founded by Mac Nattapong Vivattanaprasert, it convenes founders, corporate leaders, investors, innovators, and creators for "No Agenda" dinner conversations.

All information in this document is derived verbatim from the live website and verified records of Flow's Table (https://flowstable.net).

---

## 1. Core Facts & Organization

- **Entity**: Flow's Table (โฟลว์ส เทเบิล)
- **Founder & Host**: Mac Nattapong Vivattanaprasert (ณัฐพงษ์ วิวัฒนประเสริฐ)
- **Location**: Bangkok, Thailand
- **Official Domains**: https://flowstable.net
- **Ethos**: "No Agenda, Pure Signal" — Private, high-trust dinner conversations where participants leave pitch decks and corporate titles behind to share candid lessons on scaling, crisis management, capital allocation, and personal philosophy.
- **Offerings**:
  - **The Table**: Curated, intimate executive dinners.
  - **Flow Society**: Private executive membership circle (https://flowstable.net/flow-society).
  - **Articles & Notes**: Strategic field notes from sessions (https://flowstable.net/articles).
  - **Reels**: Short-form video highlights and quotes (https://flowstable.net/reels).
  - **Guests**: Directory of 26 distinguished speakers (https://flowstable.net/guests).

---

## 2. Directory of All 26 Featured Guests & Mentors (Verbatim from guests.html)

### Guest 1: P'Mi Tiwa Shintadapong
- **Role / Title**: President, Investors Association of Thailand
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_1.webp
- **Official Bio**: President of the Investors Association of Thailand and one of the country's most respected value investors, specializing in identifying structural economic bottlenecks and businesses with durable pricing power. He champions 'rational faith' — conviction built on deep primary research rather than crowd psychology. As a cornerstone of Flow's Table, he regularly shares his 'wisdom over information' mindset and guides the natural flow of dialogue.

### Guest 2: P'Jekky Suthon Singhasitthangkul
- **Role / Title**: Value & Crisis Opportunity Investor | Eclipse Fund Lead
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_2.webp
- **Official Bio**: A value-investing veteran with 15+ years identifying fundamentally strong businesses during market stress, panic selling, and valuation dislocation. Lead of the Eclipse Fund and creator of the proprietary 'Bottom-Fishing' strategy, he shares deep wisdom on finding value when others see only risk — believing that investing is the art of seeing value when others cannot.

### Guest 3: P'Pom Pawoot Pom Ponpipat
- **Role / Title**: Founder, TARAD.com | President, Thailand e-Commerce Association
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_3.webp
- **Official Bio**: Founder of TARAD.com, Thailand's largest C2C e-commerce platform (acquired by Rakuten in 2009), and President of the Thailand e-Commerce Association. Widely recognized as the 'Godfather of Thai E-Commerce,' he has invested in over 60 startups and launched ventures since age 23. At the table, he shares data-driven leadership strategies and hard-won lessons from building Thailand's internet ecosystem from the ground up.

### Guest 4: Shark Jing Chanapun Juangroongruangkit
- **Role / Title**: SVP, Thai Summit Group & Investor
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_4.webp
- **Official Bio**: Senior Vice President of Thai Summit Group, one of Southeast Asia's largest automotive parts manufacturers, founded by her family in 1977 and now operating across 8 countries. A prominent business leader recognized for driving automation and Industry 4.0 transformation in manufacturing, she shares insights on scaling a multi-generational industrial empire, the future of smart manufacturing, and navigating the global automotive supply chain.

### Guest 5: Dr. Kid Supachai Parchariyanon
- **Role / Title**: Co-Founder & CEO, RISE | Managing Partner, SeaX Ventures
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_5.webp
- **Official Bio**: Co-founder and CEO of RISE, Southeast Asia's premier corporate innovation accelerator, and Managing Partner at SeaX Ventures. A leading voice in the regional startup ecosystem, he mentors the community on scaling organizations through strategic innovation, building corporate-startup ecosystems, and the intersection of enterprise transformation and venture capital.

### Guest 6: P'Toy Kasidis Satangmongkol
- **Role / Title**: Founder, DataRockie & Data Science Educator
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_6.webp
- **Official Bio**: Founder of DataRockie, one of Thailand's leading data science education platforms, built as a solopreneur. A self-described 'generalist in practice, stoic at heart,' he has taught R and Python programming to thousands of students across the country. He brings a rare blend of data expertise, Stoic philosophy, and one-person-business strategy to Flow's Table conversations.

### Guest 7: P'Tre Kittipol Pramoj
- **Role / Title**: Director, Sammakorn & Racing Driver
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_7.webp
- **Official Bio**: Director of Sammakorn Public Company Limited, one of Thailand's leading real estate developers, and a competitive racing driver in the Thailand Super Series, racing a Ferrari 488 Challenge EVO in the Super Car GTM class. Also serving on the board of Tanachira Retail Corporation, he brings a rare dual perspective on calculated risk-taking—both in the boardroom and on the track.

### Guest 8: P'Mek Nithi Satchatippavarn
- **Role / Title**: Co-Founder & CEO, MyCloudFulfillment
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_8.webp
- **Official Bio**: Co-founder and CEO of MyCloudFulfillment, a tech-enabled supply chain and fulfillment platform for e-commerce businesses in Thailand. A Babson College graduate, he has successfully raised Series B funding and built one of the country's leading fulfillment services. He shares hard-won lessons on logistics optimization, scaling operations across multiple sales channels, and navigating the venture capital landscape in Southeast Asia.

### Guest 9: P'Pek Punyawe Chantarakajorn
- **Role / Title**: Professional Trader & Author
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_9.webp
- **Official Bio**: A professional trader, investor, and author of five books on financial markets and investing psychology. He shares deep expertise on trading strategy, technical analysis, and the discipline required to navigate market volatility. Beyond charts and numbers, he brings philosophical perspectives on wealth creation, business moats, and the mindset of compounding knowledge over time.

### Guest 10: P'Benz Arnun Treetitiapt
- **Role / Title**: Digital Entrepreneur & Solopreneur
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_10.webp
- **Official Bio**: A successful digital entrepreneur and solopreneur who pioneered self-funded educational courses in Thailand. At the table, he shares actionable frameworks on launching one-person businesses, designing high-margin digital products, and building active online audiences without external funding or large teams.

### Guest 11: Shark Benz Vorapat Chavananikul
- **Role / Title**: CFO & CSO, Boonrawd Trading | MD, Singha Ventures
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_11.webp
- **Official Bio**: Chief Financial Officer and Chief Strategy Officer of Boonrawd Trading (Singha), and Managing Director of Singha Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of the Boonrawd Group. He also serves as Deputy CEO of Boonrawd Trading and Director of Singha Estate. With 20+ years spanning retail, consumer goods, and finance — including prior roles at Tesco Thailand, BCG, and Optasia Capital where he executed multiple IPOs and M&A deals — he shares powerful perspectives on corporate strategy, CVC investing, and steering one of Thailand's most iconic conglomerates through digital transformation.

### Guest 12: P'Frung Narikun Ketprapakorn
- **Role / Title**: Actress, Doctor & Content Creator
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_12.webp
- **Official Bio**: A beloved Thai actress, medical doctor, and content creator who shares her journey balancing a career in medicine with media production. She brings inspiring insights on discipline, mental wellness, and finding passion across multiple careers.

### Guest 13: P'Kok Tanarat Ruckariyapong
- **Role / Title**: Vice President, SAPPE (Mogu Mogu, Beauti Drink)
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_13.webp
- **Official Bio**: Vice President of SAPPE Public Company Limited, the Thai beverage powerhouse behind globally loved brands like Mogu Mogu and Sappe Beauti, exporting to over 100 countries. Part of the Ruckariyapong family that built the company from a small snacks business in 1973 into a multi-billion-baht listed enterprise, he brings deep insights on scaling a family business, FMCG innovation, and building a global lifestyle brand from Thailand.

### Guest 14: P'Em Udomsak Rakwongwan
- **Role / Title**: Co-Founder & Advisor, Forward DeFi | Asst. Prof., Kasetsart University
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_14.webp
- **Official Bio**: Co-founder and advisor of Forward (Project Forward), a decentralized finance platform, and Assistant Professor of Mathematics at Kasetsart University with a Ph.D. in Financial Mathematics. He bridges the worlds of academic rigor and DeFi innovation, sharing deep expertise on algorithmic trading, blockchain architecture, and the future of decentralized financial systems.

### Guest 15: P'Peesamac Peesadech Pechnoi
- **Role / Title**: Co-Founder, BASE Playhouse | Learning Designer & Technologist
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_15.webp
- **Official Bio**: Co-founder of BASE Playhouse and a learning designer and technologist specializing in creative marketing and innovation strategy. With a background spanning brand campaigns and platform-based knowledge management, he brings fresh perspectives on blending education, technology, and storytelling to build engaging experiences that resonate with modern audiences.

### Guest 16: P'Golf Natthakorn Wiangin
- **Role / Title**: Tech & Media Strategy
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_16.webp
- **Official Bio**: A tech and media strategy professional with experience spanning digital content, brand innovation, and the future of Thai media in the AI era. He shares insights on how traditional media companies are adapting to AI disruption, platform strategy, and the evolving relationship between technology and storytelling.

### Guest 17: P'Nui Pongsuk Hiranprueck
- **Role / Title**: Managing Director, Show No Limit & Host of Beartai Hitech
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_17.webp
- **Official Bio**: Managing Director of Show No Limit, a leading event and digital media company in Bangkok. As the long-running host of Beartai Hitech, Thailand's most influential tech TV program, and founder of the Thailand Game Show, he has been at the forefront of the country's tech media landscape for over two decades. He shares deep insights on bridging technology with mass audiences, digital media production, and the evolution of Thailand's gaming and tech communities.

### Guest 18: P'Shane Prachaya Mora
- **Role / Title**: Managing Director, SERVgroup
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_18.webp
- **Official Bio**: Managing Director of SERVgroup, a Thai hospitality and lifestyle company. A successful young entrepreneur who found early business success in his 20s, he brings perspectives on hospitality branding, operational excellence, and building premium service businesses that stand apart in a competitive market.

### Guest 19: P'Phone Ruttanun Vilailuck
- **Role / Title**: Third-Generation Leader, Samart Corporation
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_19.webp
- **Official Bio**: Third-generation leader of Samart Corporation, a Thai conglomerate founded in 1955 with 40 affiliates, four of which are listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. He leads Samart's strategic push to invest its own capital in technology concessions for government projects, earning long-term recurring revenue. Growing up at a dinner table where business was discussed like a strategy session, he shares unique perspectives on multi-generational enterprise, government tech infrastructure, and the aviation and telecom sectors.

### Guest 20: P'Pol Amorpol Huvanandana
- **Role / Title**: Co-Founder & CEO, Moreloop
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_20.webp
- **Official Bio**: Co-founder and CEO of Moreloop, a circular economy platform that upcycles surplus fabric from garment factories into high-value products. Since 2018, Moreloop has rescued 40 tons of fabric and prevented over 630 tons of CO2 emissions. He brings deep insights on building a social enterprise, scaling sustainability business models, and proving that environmental impact and profitability can go hand in hand.

### Guest 21: P'Pat Naranpat Thitipattakul
- **Role / Title**: Managing Partner, Disrupt Health Impact Fund
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_21.webp
- **Official Bio**: Managing Partner of Disrupt Health Impact Fund, a Thailand-based venture capital firm investing in world-class HealthTech startups across five key areas: self-care, preventive care, silver age, holistic wellness, and smart hospitals. Alongside chairman Krating Poonpol, she leads investments of 17-50 million baht per company, backing deep-tech innovators like DiaMonTech (non-invasive glucose monitoring) and PocDoc. She shares sharp insights on evaluating health-tech founders, the future of preventive healthcare in Southeast Asia, and bridging global deep-tech into Thailand's world-class medical ecosystem.

### Guest 22: P'Popp Polpat Songthamjitti
- **Role / Title**: Co-Founder, GetLinks & Managing Partner, WhaleGround
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_22.webp
- **Official Bio**: Co-founder and CMO of GetLinks, a curated tech talent marketplace connecting 25 million professionals across Asia, and a Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia honoree. Now Managing Partner at WhaleGround, a Web3 venture capital firm, he shares insights on scaling cross-border startups, community-driven growth, and navigating the intersection of talent, technology, and decentralized finance.

### Guest 23: P'Pound Trikachon Siritawechai
- **Role / Title**: Founder, Woonplaepasa & Content Creator
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_23.webp
- **Official Bio**: Founder of Woonplaepasa (วุ้นแปลภาษา), one of Thailand's most viral language content brands known for blending humor with language education. Through OP CREATOR, he has built a massive following by making English accessible and entertaining. At the table, he shares lessons on building engaged communities through content, the creator economy, and turning passion into a sustainable business.

### Guest 24: P'Can Tossapat Chunrahas
- **Role / Title**: Professional Poker Player & Investor
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_24.webp
- **Official Bio**: One of Thailand's top-ranked professional poker players with over $127,000 in live tournament earnings, including a High Roller title at Poker Dream Vietnam. Beyond the felt, he is an active investor connected with KANEKOJI Group and Basecamp Ventures. He brings unique perspectives on risk management, decision-making under pressure, and the psychology of calculated bets—skills that translate directly from the poker table to business and investing.

### Guest 25: P'Ton Tanongsak Saeaw
- **Role / Title**: Founder & CEO, Yuedpao (ยืดเปล่า)
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_25.webp
- **Official Bio**: Founder and CEO of Yuedpao (ยืดเปล่า), one of Thailand's most beloved t-shirt and apparel brands with over 875,000 Facebook fans and 358,000+ TikTok followers. Starting from a small reselling business in 2013, he grew Yuedpao into a hundreds-of-millions-baht brand with the viral philosophy of selling to make friends, not just profit. A pioneer in sustainable fashion through the ReWear ReCare collaboration with PT and Circular, he shares hard-won lessons on brand building, defending thin margins, and competing against Chinese garment imports with authentic Thai storytelling.

### Guest 26: P'Thoy Piyathida Chitaroon
- **Role / Title**: Actress, Entrepreneur & Purpose Coach
- **Photo Path**: assets/photos/guests/guest_26.webp
- **Official Bio**: A celebrated Thai actress known for hit dramas including Baan Sila Dang (เลือดข้นหนึง), who has successfully transitioned into a multi-venture entrepreneur and purpose-driven coach with over 127,000 Instagram followers. As founder of FitU Academy, FitU Health Club, and SOS Sense of Style, she empowers others in health, fitness, and personal branding. A Thammasat University graduate, she shares inspiring perspectives on balancing a creative career with business building, faith-driven leadership, and living with purpose.
